recipe.build:
rm -rf .git
sed -r 's/include ".*arm.*"\s*$/include "arm64-v8a"/ ; s/versionName "2.0"/versionName "2.1"/' -i app/build.gradle
sed -r 's!C:/~buildirs/\$\{project.name\}!/build/repo!i' -i build.gradle
git clone https://codeberg.org/IzzyOnDroid/gradlew.py.git
gradlew.py/gradlew.py --version 8.14 -v assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT="outputs/apk/release/dejpeg-release-arm64-v8a-*.apk"
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 16 fix-newlines $OUT 'META-INF/services/*'
mv $OUT /outputs/unsigned.apk
